description: Relative flash power curves for EX estimates. Prefer official range + ideal stop math; lab curves TBD.
uncertainty: Unless status=measured, relativeOutput is estimated from stop math or display mapping — not a calibrated lux/f-stop table.

curves.assumption: relative_energy ∝ 2^(-stops_from_full); valid only for proportional-output strobes in M mode
curves.source: Photographic stop math (1 stop = ×2 energy). See learnstudiolighting.com flash power & exposure stops.
curves.notes: Not a lab-measured curve. Real heads deviate at low power / HSS / color modes.

curves.assumption: Display N → stopsFromFull = 10−N (1.0 display step ≈ 1 stop)
curves.source: Godox Photography Lighting Catalogue EN — SK/MS/DP power control notes (5.0–10.0 / 4.0–10.0)
curves.notes: Maps display numbers onto ideal proportional curve; not a measured lux table.

curves.assumption: Whole numbers = full f-stops; decimals = 1/10 stop (Scoro / Siros family docs)
curves.source: broncolor Helpjuice — Scoro energy control; Siros family energy display conventions
curves.notes: Absolute joules depend on pack; this curve is relative to selected channel full. Pending per-model verification.
